title: Breast Cancer Screening - User Input Schema
description: User-facing input specification for the Wisconsin Diagnostic Breast Cancer 30 morphometric cell nucleus features.

mean_features.name: radius_mean
mean_features.description: Mean distance from center to points on the cell nucleus perimeter

mean_features.name: texture_mean
mean_features.description: Mean of gray-scale values (standard deviation of gray-scale)

mean_features.name: smoothness_mean
mean_features.description: Mean local variation in cell nucleus radius lengths

mean_features.name: concavity_mean
mean_features.description: Mean severity of concave portions of the nucleus contour

mean_features.name: concave points_mean
mean_features.description: Mean number of concave portions of the nucleus contour

mean_features.name: symmetry_mean
mean_features.description: Mean symmetry of the cell nucleus

se_features.name: radius_se
se_features.description: Standard error for the radius of the cell nucleus

se_features.name: texture_se
se_features.description: Standard error for gray-scale value variation

se_features.name: perimeter_se
se_features.description: Standard error for the cell nucleus perimeter

se_features.name: area_se
se_features.description: Standard error for the cell nucleus area

se_features.name: smoothness_se
se_features.description: Standard error for local variation in radius lengths

se_features.name: concave points_se
se_features.description: Standard error for concave portions count

se_features.name: symmetry_se
se_features.description: Standard error for cell nucleus symmetry

worst_features.name: smoothness_worst
worst_features.description: Largest (worst) local variation in radius lengths

worst_features.name: concavity_worst
worst_features.description: Largest (worst) severity of concave contour portions

worst_features.name: concave points_worst
worst_features.description: Largest (worst) number of concave contour portions
